sources: In-game Rules screen (War Time, Week 1), recorded 2026-11-26

desc.id: Server No.1 tiap grup memasang angka (bisa diganti, jeda 12 jam).
desc.en: Each group's No.1 server sets a number (changeable, 12-hour cooldown).

desc.id: Pembagian faksi dan posisi warzone terlihat sampai pra-musim selesai.
desc.en: Faction split and warzone positions are visible until the pre-season ends.

desc.id: Rebut Capitol tanpa syarat wilayah bersebelahan, maksimal 4 jam. Pemimpin aliansi pemenang jadi President.
desc.en: Fight for the Capitol without adjacent land, up to 4 hours. The winning alliance's leader becomes President.

desc.id: Peta Shadow Rainforest dibuka. Bangun Fungus Institute di hari pertama.
desc.en: The Shadow Rainforest map opens. Build the Fungus Institute on day 1.

desc.id: Donasi bersama untuk membuka Fungus Institute (Virus Resistance).
desc.en: Warzone donation that unlocks the Fungus Institute (Virus Resistance).

desc.id: Ranking kill zombie season (sampai level 50), 9 hari.
desc.en: Season zombie-kill ranking (up to level 50), 9 days.

desc.id: Ranking aliansi merebut Fishing Grounds, 14 hari.
desc.en: Alliance ranking for capturing Fishing Grounds, 14 days.

desc.id: Mini-game season dibuka. Mode duel menyusul di minggu 2.
desc.en: The season mini-game opens. Duel mode follows in week 2.

desc.id: Mulai rebut Fishing Grounds dan memancing.
desc.en: Start capturing Fishing Grounds and fishing.

desc.id: City Clash S6 dimulai. R4/R5 deklarasi perang ke kota yang wilayahnya tersambung.
desc.en: City Clash S6 begins. R4/R5 declare war on cities connected to your territory.

desc.id: Battle Pass Awakening Kimberly, 7 hari. Syarat: bintang 5, Exclusive Weapon lv.20+.
desc.en: Kimberly's Awakening Battle Pass, 7 days. Needs 5 stars and Exclusive Weapon lv.20+.

desc.id: Butuh Alert Tower lv.27. Hari pastinya belum terkonfirmasi.
desc.en: Needs Alert Tower lv.27. Exact day not confirmed.

desc.id: Fishing Grounds di warzone faksi lawan mulai bisa diserang.
desc.en: Fishing Grounds in enemy-faction warzones can now be attacked.

desc.id: Rebut Trade Post.
desc.en: Capture Trade Posts.

desc.id: Ibu kota warzone. Merebut Sanctuary sendiri memberi 200.000 Influence ke 60 aliansi teratas faksi.
desc.en: The warzone capital. Capturing your own gives the faction's top 60 alliances 200,000 Influence.

desc.id: Kota faksi lawan mulai bisa dihancurkan. Penghancuran permanen.
desc.en: Enemy-faction cities can now be destroyed. Destruction is permanent.

desc.id: Promosi Braz SSR bintang 5 ke UR (butuh 1 UR Hero Badge).
desc.en: Promote 5-star SSR Braz to UR (needs 1 UR Hero Badge).

desc.id: Sesuai panduan aliansi. Syarat: bintang 5, Exclusive Weapon lv.20+.
desc.en: Per the alliance guide. Needs 5 stars and Exclusive Weapon lv.20+.

desc.id: 1 jam, tanpa syarat wilayah bersebelahan. Maksimal 3 Altar per aliansi.
desc.en: 1 hour, no adjacency needed. Max 3 Altars per alliance.

desc.id: Sesuai panduan aliansi. Syarat: bintang 5, Exclusive Weapon lv.20+.
desc.en: Per the alliance guide. Needs 5 stars and Exclusive Weapon lv.20+.

desc.id: Jam mulai belum diketahui, cek in-game.
desc.en: Start time not known yet, check in game.

desc.id: Faksi pertama yang mencapai 100% dapat 30 juta Influence.
desc.en: The first faction to reach 100% earns 30 million Influence.

desc.id: 3 Battle Time (@1 jam, jam cek in-game): Fishing Ground & kota yang sudah direbut dan tidak dilindungi bisa diserang. Kunci satu jendela dengan Alliance Safe Time.
desc.en: 3 Battle Times (1 hour each, check times in game): captured Fishing Grounds and cities not under protection can be attacked. Lock one window with Alliance Safe Time.

title.en: War day · bases can be attacked

desc.id: Seperti Rabu, ditambah base komandan bisa diserang warzone lain. Pasang Shield kalau tidak ikut perang!
desc.en: Same as Wednesday, plus Commander bases can be attacked by other warzones. Activate a Shield if you are not fighting!

desc.id: Tidak ada perang. Hadiah berdasarkan peringkat Influence.
desc.en: No more war. Rewards by Influence ranking.

desc.id: Black Market (lengkapi shard Exclusive Weapon), lalu off-season.
desc.en: Black Market (complete Exclusive Weapon shards), then off-season.
